convars.help: (Generated) Enables structural stability simulation; when disabled buildings will not collapse even if their supports are destroyed

convars.name: server.maxunack
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum number of unacknowledged network messages per connection before the server starts applying backpressure to that client

convars.name: server.maxItemStacksMovedPerTickIndustrial
convars.help: How many stacks a single conveyor can move in a single tick

convars.name: server.maximumMapMarkers
convars.help: How many markers each player can place

convars.name: server.maximumPings
convars.help: How many pings can be placed by each player

convars.name: server.maxFoodSpoilTimeDiffForItemStack
convars.help: Maximum difference (in seconds) that two items with spoil timers can have and still be stackable

convars.name: server.maxpacketspersecond_world
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum world-state update packets per second accepted from each individual client; prevents flooding the server with position spam

convars.name: server.maxpacketspersecond_rpc
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum RPC (Remote Procedure Call) packets per second accepted from each client; limits how fast clients can trigger server-side actions

convars.name: server.maxpacketspersecond_rpc_signal
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum RPC signal packets per second accepted from each client; signal RPCs are lightweight event triggers used for interactions

convars.name: server.maxpacketspersecond_command
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum console command packets per second accepted from each client; rate-limits how quickly clients can send commands to the server

convars.name: server.maxpacketsize_command
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum byte size of a single console command packet from a client; oversized packets are rejected

convars.name: server.maxpacketsize_globaltrees
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum byte size of a single global-trees network packet; oversized packets are dropped

convars.name: server.maxpacketsize_globalentities
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum byte size of a single global-entities network packet; oversized packets are dropped

convars.name: server.maxpacketsize_voicedata
convars.help: Maximum number of bytes permitted in VoiceData packets, oversized packets will be dropped

convars.name: server.maxpacketspersecond_tick
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum tick-update packets per second accepted from each client; these carry player inputs and must stay within this rate to be processed

convars.name: server.maxpacketspersecond_voice
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum voice chat packets per second accepted from each client; reducing this limits voice bandwidth usage per player

convars.name: server.maxpacketspersecond_syncvar
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum sync-var (replicated variable) update packets per second accepted from each client

convars.name: stability.verbose
convars.help: (Generated) Verbosity level for stability system logging; 0 = silent, higher values print more detail about stability calculations and propagation

convars.name: stability.strikes
convars.help: (Generated) Number of stability propagation iterations performed per tick; higher values resolve complex multi-block stability chains faster at the cost of CPU time

convars.name: stability.collapse
convars.help: (Generated) Stability value below which a building block is considered unsupported and will collapse; default 0.05 means blocks below 5% support fall

convars.name: stability.accuracy
convars.help: (Generated) Floating-point tolerance used when comparing stability values during propagation; smaller values are more precise but can cause more recalculations

convars.name: stability.stabilityqueue
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum time in seconds that stability update jobs can run per server tick before being deferred to the next tick

convars.name: stability.surroundingsqueue
convars.help: (Generated) Maximum time in seconds that surrounding-support check jobs can run per server tick before deferral

convars.name: stability.log_stability_death
convars.help: (Generated) When enabled, logs each entity death caused by a stability collapse to the server console with position and prefab name

convars.name: stability.log_ground_missing_death
convars.help: (Generated) When enabled, logs when entities die because their ground support entity was destroyed or is missing

convars.name: stability.log_stability_updates
convars.help: (Generated) When enabled, logs every stability value change during propagation; very verbose, use only for targeted debugging
